summary: StepStone Private Credit Fund LLC filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned SPV, StepStone SPV Facility III LLC, as borrower, entered an October 15, 2026 fifth amendment to its Wells Fargo-administered Loan and Security Agreement. The amendment raises aggregate lender commitments to $1.0 billion with an accordion to $1.5 billion, extends the reinvestment period to October 15, 2029 and maturity to October 15, 2031, and lowers the applicable margin to 1.95%, with revised non-use fees. This is a routine credit-facility repricing and extension, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
